summary: May 5 2026: S&P 500 +0.78%, Nasdaq +0.90%, Dow +0.52%, Russell 2000 +1.41%. Markets rebounding after May 4 sell-off driven by Iran-UAE missile interception. Nasdaq hit new all-time intraday high. May 4 Dow fell 557 points (-1.13%) on Middle East escalation. S&P 500 earlier hit records the prior week (May 1).
